result.topic_en: Pencil calculations on solving a linear substitution x = a y by determinants (minors with upper and lower indices, Cramer's rule, a Laplace-type expansion of a 5x5 determinant), on products of powers of linear forms, and on expanding products of differences of roots (discriminant-like expressions in α, α_1, α_2, α_3).

methods.what: Linear substitution of variables x in terms of y written as x = (a, y)
Eliminating variables via 2x2 minors (combining two equations)
Expansion of a 3x3 minor along a row by 2x2 minors
Laplace expansion of a 5x5 determinant into products of 2x2 and 3x3 minors
Cramer's rule: solving for y_n by determinants

Transformation of a product of powers of linear forms with determinant factors (multiplicativity of determinants)
